name: What is the difference between a home extension and a renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a home extension and a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A home extension involves adding new square footage to your existing structure, physically expanding the footprint or vertical space of your home. This might include building new rooms, adding a second story, or expanding existing rooms outwards. A renovation, on the other hand, focuses on updating, repairing, or transforming existing spaces within the current footprint, such as remodeling a kitchen or bathroom. Extensions inherently require more extensive structural work and permitting.
acceptedAnswer.description: An extension adds new physical space to your home's footprint, while a renovation updates or transforms existing spaces within its current boundaries.
